tool_args.rationale: All five memory states must be reconstructed from irregular prefixes using the same unknown time constant that governs the forecast. The fine trajectory batch targets this parameter ambiguity before confirmation; the pilot horizons already bracket the target horizon of 0.45.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter coupled memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five terminal targets come from similar step histories. Because the latent memory is unobserved, changes in its time constant can trade off against coupling and drive, leaving fresh forecasts uncertain despite a close pilot fit.
The observed history gap already favors the coupled-memory branch; the immediate need is to separate its parameters using more transient observations.

considered_alternatives.option: Single-mode Maxwell decay or Kelvin–Voigt creep
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Maxwell decay predicts negative values after downward steps, contrary to the pilot. The recalled Kelvin–Voigt law discards prefix history and cannot explain the endpoint-matched history gap.
